title: GridContainer: `stretch_ratio` ignored when all children have expand flag set
body: ### Tested versions Godot v4.7.1.stable.mono ### System information Windows 11 (build 28120) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12450H (12 threads) - 39.72 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description I'm a bit confused about the behavior of GridContainer's stretch_ratio property and I'm wondering if this is intentional or a bug. I set up a GridContainer with columns = 2, and added two Panel children. Both panels have size_flags_horizontal = 3 (EXPAND + FILL). I set stretch_ratio = 2.0 on the first panel and left the second at the default 1.0. I expected the left panel to take 2/3 of the width and the right panel 1/3, but instead they split the width equally. The stretch_ratio seems to have no effect at all. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a new scene with a GridContainer as the root node. 2. Set columns = 2 and anchor the container to full rect (or set a fixed width). 3. Add two Panel nodes as children. 4. For both panels, set size_flags_horizontal = 3 (EXPAND + FILL). 5. For the first panel, set stretch_ratio = 2.0. Leave the second panel at 1.0. 6. Run the scene or view it in the editor. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) tscn [gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://bmwvhf7utbjco"] [node name="GridContainer" type="GridContainer" unique_id=2085411327] anchors_preset = 15 anchor_right = 1.0 anchor_bottom = 1.0 grow_horizontal = 2 grow_vertical = 2 columns = 2 [node name="Panel" type="Panel" parent="." unique_id=1958389316] layout_mode = 2 size_flags_horizontal = 3 size_flags_vertical = 3 size_flags_stretch_ratio = 2.0 [node name="Panel2" type="Panel" parent="." unique_id=1778730434] layout_mode = 2 size_flags_horizontal = 3
